summary: Cuts up the audio on a track in time with the song: Stutter (repeats the last slice with pitch, decay and filter per repeat), Repeat (a bar-end loop of a grid slice, with chance and variation), Retrigger (jumps back to the start of the beat or bar on a grid), Tape stop and start, a 16-step Gate and an Auto-pan. The four cutting modes start in sync with the song, from a note (a note wire or the track's own note column) or both; the Gate and the Pan lock to the song or run free. Mix and Amount; every cut is crossfaded. Use it for stutters, glitches, drum fills, bar-end repeats, tape stops, trance-style gating and wide panning.
use_for: Cut up a track in time with the song: stutter, bar-end repeat, retrigger, tape stop and start, a 16-step gate and auto-pan, started by the beat or by notes, for fills, glitches and chopping.

parameters.name: Stutter
parameters.description: The stutter mode: on or off
parameters.how: Turns the stutter on or off.
parameters.sound: On, the end of every period repeats the last slice of the audio.

parameters.name: Stutter trigger
parameters.description: What starts a stutter: the song (at the end of each period), a note, or both
parameters.how: Chooses whether the song, a note or both start the stutter.
parameters.sound: Synced stutters on the beat grid by themselves; Note stutters when you play a note.

parameters.name: Stutter every
parameters.description: Synced: the period; each stutter ends on its end
parameters.how: Sets how often a synced stutter happens, from every beat to every 8 bars.
parameters.sound: Short periods make a constant glitch, long ones a fill at the end of a phrase.

parameters.name: Slice
parameters.description: Length of the slice that repeats (a quarter note is a beat)
parameters.how: Sets the note value of the repeated slice.
parameters.sound: Long slices repeat a piece of the groove, short ones turn into a buzz.

parameters.name: Slice feel
parameters.description: Straight, dotted (x1.5) or triplet (x2/3) slices
parameters.how: Makes the slice straight, dotted or triplet.
parameters.sound: Dotted slices lilt, triplet slices roll.

parameters.name: Repeats
parameters.description: Number of times the slice plays (Hold: until the note ends, or half the period when synced)
parameters.how: Sets how many times the slice plays, or Hold for as long as the note is down.
parameters.sound: Few repeats make a short stammer, Hold a freeze.

parameters.name: Pitch per repeat
parameters.description: Semitones each repeat is higher (or lower) than the one before
parameters.how: Shifts the pitch of every repeat by this much more than the last.
parameters.sound: Up gives a rising roll, down a falling one; 0 keeps the pitch.

parameters.name: Decay per repeat
parameters.description: Level each repeat loses against the one before
parameters.how: Makes each repeat quieter by this many decibels.
parameters.sound: A little decay fades the stutter out, none holds it level.

parameters.name: Filter per repeat
parameters.description: Octaves per repeat: below 0 a low-pass closes down, above 0 a high-pass opens up
parameters.how: Moves a filter by this many octaves with each repeat: left of centre it darkens, right of centre it thins.
parameters.sound: Darkening repeats sink into the mix; thinning ones fly away.

parameters.name: Repeat
parameters.description: The repeat mode: on or off
parameters.how: Turns the repeat on or off.
parameters.sound: On, the end of the chosen bars loops a small grid slice.

parameters.name: Repeat trigger
parameters.description: What starts a repeat: the song (at the end of each interval), a note, or both
parameters.how: Chooses whether the song, a note or both start the repeat.
parameters.sound: Synced repeats fill the end of the interval by themselves.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description: Synced: the period; each repeat ends on its end
parameters.how: Sets how many bars pass between repeats.
parameters.sound: One bar gives a fill in every bar, eight bars a rare one.

parameters.name: Chance
parameters.description: The chance that a repeat happens at an interval
parameters.how: Sets how likely each interval is to get a repeat.
parameters.sound: Below 100 % the repeat comes and goes at random, the same way on every play.

parameters.name: Length
parameters.description: How long the repeat lasts, as a part of a bar (never longer than the interval)
parameters.how: Sets how long the repeat runs, counted back from the end of the interval.
parameters.sound: A short length is a quick fill, a long one loops a whole phrase.

parameters.name: Grid
parameters.description: Length of the slice that loops (a quarter note is a beat)
parameters.how: Sets the note value of the looped slice.
parameters.sound: Coarse grids loop a piece of the groove, fine grids buzz.

parameters.name: Grid feel
parameters.description: Straight, dotted (x1.5) or triplet (x2/3) grid
parameters.how: Makes the grid straight, dotted or triplet.
parameters.sound: Dotted lilts, triplet rolls.

parameters.name: Variation
parameters.description: The chance that a loop of the slice is cut to half or a quarter of the grid (seeded)
parameters.how: Makes some loops of the slice shorter at random.
parameters.sound: More variation gives a busier, less predictable glitch; the same on every play.

parameters.name: Retrigger
parameters.description: The retrigger mode: on or off
parameters.how: Turns the retrigger on or off.
parameters.sound: On, the audio keeps jumping back to the start of the beat or bar.

parameters.name: Retrigger trigger
parameters.description: What starts a retrigger: the song (at the start of its window), a note, or both
parameters.how: Chooses whether the song, a note or both start the retrigger.
parameters.sound: Synced retriggers happen at the end of each period.

parameters.name: Retrigger every
parameters.description: Synced: the period; each retrigger window ends on its end
parameters.how: Sets how often a synced retrigger window comes.
parameters.sound: Every bar makes a stammering end to each bar.

parameters.name: Retrigger length
parameters.description: How long the retrigger window lasts, as a part of a bar (never longer than the period)
parameters.how: Sets how long the retrigger runs, counted back from the end of the period.
parameters.sound: Half a bar is a classic fill.

parameters.name: Retrigger grid
parameters.description: How often the audio jumps back (a quarter note is a beat)
parameters.how: Sets the note value between jumps.
parameters.sound: Fine grids stammer, coarse ones loop.

parameters.name: Retrigger feel
parameters.description: Straight, dotted (x1.5) or triplet (x2/3) grid
parameters.how: Makes the jumps straight, dotted or triplet.
parameters.sound: Dotted lilts, triplet rolls.

parameters.name: Back to
parameters.description: Where each jump goes back to: the start of the current beat or of the current bar
parameters.how: Chooses whether the audio jumps back to the start of the beat or the bar.
parameters.sound: Beat repeats a small piece, Bar replays the phrase from its start.

parameters.name: Tape
parameters.description: The tape stop and start mode: on or off
parameters.how: Turns the tape stop on or off.
parameters.sound: On, the audio winds down to a stop and spins back up.

parameters.name: Tape trigger
parameters.description: What starts a tape stop: the song (so that it stops on the end of each period), a note (held until the note ends), or both
parameters.how: Chooses whether the song, a note or both start the tape stop.
parameters.sound: A note stops the tape and lets it go again when it ends.

parameters.name: Tape every
parameters.description: Synced: the period; the tape is stopped on its end
parameters.how: Sets how often a synced tape stop happens.
parameters.sound: Every 4 bars gives a stop at the end of a phrase.

parameters.name: Stop sync
parameters.description: The stop time as a note value of the song (Free: the Stop time in ms)
parameters.how: Sets whether the stop time is in milliseconds or in note values.
parameters.sound: Synced stops always last the same part of the beat.

parameters.name: Stop time
parameters.description: How long the slowdown to a stop takes, when Stop sync is Free
parameters.how: Sets how long the tape takes to wind down.
parameters.sound: Short stops are abrupt, long ones sink slowly.

parameters.name: Stop curve
parameters.description: Shape of the slowdown: left of centre it slows early and trails off, right of centre it keeps speed and stops late
parameters.how: Bends the slowdown.
parameters.sound: Left slows early and drags, right keeps going and then drops.

parameters.name: Start sync
parameters.description: The start time as a note value of the song (Free: the Start time in ms)
parameters.how: Sets whether the start time is in milliseconds or in note values.
parameters.sound: Synced starts always last the same part of the beat.

parameters.name: Start time
parameters.description: How long the spin-up takes, when Start sync is Free (0: the sound returns at once)
parameters.how: Sets how long the tape takes to spin back up.
parameters.sound: Short starts snap back, long ones swoop up from below.

parameters.name: Gate
parameters.description: The step gate: on or off
parameters.how: Turns the step gate on or off.
parameters.sound: On, the 16 steps cut the sound into a rhythm.

parameters.name: Gate lock
parameters.description: Song: the steps follow the song position; Free: they run on their own at the song tempo, even when stopped
parameters.how: Chooses whether the gate follows the song or runs free.
parameters.sound: Song keeps the gate on the grid; Free lets it drift against the beat.

parameters.name: Gate rate
parameters.description: The length of one step (a quarter note is a beat)
parameters.how: Sets the note value of one step.
parameters.sound: Slow rates chop out beats, fast ones turn the sound into a stutter.

parameters.name: Gate attack
parameters.description: How long a step takes to open
parameters.how: Sets how softly the gate opens.
parameters.sound: Short is a hard cut-in, long a swell.

parameters.name: Gate release
parameters.description: How long a step takes to close
parameters.how: Sets how softly the gate closes.
parameters.sound: Short is chopped off, long rings on.

parameters.name: Gate depth
parameters.description: How far an off step closes: 100 % is silence
parameters.how: Sets how far the gate closes on the steps that are off.
parameters.sound: Full depth is a hard rhythm, partial depth is a pulse.

parameters.name: Accent
parameters.description: Extra level on accented steps
parameters.how: Sets how much louder the accented steps are.
parameters.sound: Accents push the rhythm forward.

parameters.name: Step 1
parameters.description: Step 1 of the gate: off, on or accent
parameters.how: Sets this step to closed, open or open and louder.
parameters.sound: Off cuts the sound, On lets it through, Accent pushes it.

parameters.name: Pan
parameters.description: The auto-pan: on or off
parameters.how: Turns the auto-pan on or off.
parameters.sound: On, the sound swings between left and right.

parameters.name: Pan sync
parameters.description: The pan cycle as a length in the song (Free: the Pan rate in Hz)
parameters.how: Sets whether the pan follows a note length of the song or runs in Hz.
parameters.sound: Synced pans lock to the beat, Free pans drift.

parameters.name: Pan rate
parameters.description: Cycles per second, when Pan sync is Free
parameters.how: Sets how fast the pan swings.
parameters.sound: Slow sweeps, fast flutters.

parameters.name: Pan depth
parameters.description: How far the sound swings to each side: 100 % is hard left and right
parameters.how: Sets how wide the pan swings.
parameters.sound: Small depths sway, full depth throws it to the sides.

parameters.name: Pan shape
parameters.description: The shape of the swing; the square has its edges rounded over the Smoothness time
parameters.how: Chooses the shape of the swing.
parameters.sound: Sine is smooth, triangle steady, square jumps from side to side.

parameters.name: Pan phase
parameters.description: Where in its cycle the swing starts, in degrees
parameters.how: Shifts the swing in time.
parameters.sound: 90 degrees starts it at the right, 180 at the other side.

parameters.name: Smoothness
parameters.description: The crossfade at every slice, repeat, jump and step edge (at least 2 ms)
parameters.how: Sets how long every cut is crossfaded.
parameters.sound: Short is crisp and may tick, long is soft and rounds off the attack.

parameters.name: Note picks slice
parameters.description: A note chooses the slice or grid by its key (C = 1/4, up the twelve keys to 1/64 triplet) instead of the setting
parameters.how: Lets the key of a note choose the slice length.
parameters.sound: Play a different key for a different roll.

parameters.name: Mix
parameters.description: Dry/wet (the dry signal is not delayed: there is no latency)
parameters.how: Blends the cut sound with the dry input.
parameters.sound: Lower values keep the original and lay the cuts on top.

parameters.name: Amount
parameters.description: Effect strength: 100 % = the settings as they stand, 0 = clean (bit for bit the input), 200 % = exaggerated
parameters.how: Scales the stutter pitch, decay and filter, the repeat chance and the depth of the gate and the pan together.
parameters.sound: Turn it down to fade the chopping out without changing its rhythm, up to push it harder; at 0 the sound is clean.
